summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-161-AWS Publication Date: 11/02/2026 08:30 AM PST Description: We are aware of CVE-2026-119301 in the Apache Iceberg write component, where improper neutralization of quoting syntax in SQL identifier construction could allow an authenticated user with permission to modify AWS Glue Data Catalog metadata to read any table that a separate, more privileged principal can access and write to the table that principal is updating via a crafted column name. Impacted versions: awswrangler >= 3.5.2, < 3.17.1 Please refer to the article below for the most up-to-date and complete information related to this AWS Security Bulletin. Read this article
title: CVE-2026-119301 - Improper neutralization of quoting syntax in Apache Iceberg SQL identifier generation in AWS SDK for pandas

summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-162-AWS Publication Date: 11/02/2026 09:30 AM PST Description: Virtual Engineering Workbench (VEW) is an open-source platform where platform engineers define and publish development environments, and developers provision them on demand through a web portal. We identified CVE-2026-119085, where improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine in the publishing component of Amazon Virtual Engineering Workbench (VEW) could allow a remote authenticated third party to run arbitrary code with the permissions of the publishing Lambda's IAM role. Impacted versions: All commits before c146486 (PR #31, merged 2026-05-04) Please refer to the article below for the most up-to-date and complete information related to this AWS Security Bulletin. Read this article
title: CVE-2026-119085 - Template injection in the publishing component of Virtual Engineering Workbench

summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-163-AWS Publication Date: 11/02/2026 11:00 AM PST Description: aidlc-traceability is an open source command-line tool, formerly published in the awslabs/aidlc-workflows repository, that generates traceability-matrix reports from a project's AI-DLC artifact files. We identified CVE-2026-120497, where stored cross-site scripting (XSS) in the HTML report generator in the aidlc-traceability CLI could allow an actor who can modify a project's AI-DLC artifact files to execute arbitrary script in the browser of a user who opens a generated HTML traceability report via crafted artifact titles or descriptions. Impacted versions: >=0.1.0 AND <commit 96cf0ea (fixed 2026-07-03) Please refer to the article below for the most up-to-date and complete information related to this AWS Security Bulletin. Read this article
title: CVE-2026-120497 - Stored cross-site scripting in the HTML report generator of aidlc-traceability in AWS AI-DLC Workflows

summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-164-AWS Publication Date: 11/02/2026 13:30 PM PST Description: We identified CVE-2026-116635. Under certain conditions, improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory in the deployment status component of the MCP server might allow an actor who can influence the MCP agent to read the contents of JSON files outside the intended deployment status directory. Where write access has been enabled, to create or overwrite JSON files outside that directory. Impacted versions: < v0.2.1 of awslabs.aws-serverless-mcp-server Please refer to the article below for the most up-to-date and complete information related to this AWS Security Bulletin. Read this article
title: CVE-2026-116635 - Improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory in the deployment status component of the AWS Serverless MCP Server

title: CVE-2026-119922 - Babelfish for PostgreSQL Privilege Escalation

We identified CVE-2026-121652, where a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) issue in the library's popup and geofence-control rendering. summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-168-AWS Publication Date: 11/03/2026 13:00 PM PST Description: We identified CVE-2026-119084, an issue in Amazon Redshift JDBC Driver versions prior to 2.3.0. Under certain conditions, the driver could load and execute arbitrary classes when processing JDBC connection URL parameters or AWS credentials profile fields. Impacted versions: Amazon Redshift JDBC Driver < 2.3.0 Please refer to the article below for the most up-to-date and complete information related to this AWS Security Bulletin. Read this article
title: CVE-2026-119084 - Remote Code Execution via Unsafe Class Loading in Amazon Redshift JDBC Driver Connection Parameters

summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-169-AWS Publication Date: 11/04/2026 11:30 AM PST Description: We identified CVE-2026-122192, an issue in Firecracker v0.23.0 through v1.16.1 that, under certain host memory conditions, can let a root user in a guest read or modify memory of the Firecracker process. It affects VMs restored from a snapshot using the File memory backend with a balloon or virtio-mem device. Impacted versions: Firecracker v0.23.0 through v1.16.1, inclusive. Refer to the article below for the most up-to-date and complete information. Read this article
title: CVE-2026-122192 - Guest Access to Firecracker Process Memory After a Failed Memory Discard

summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-170-AWS Publication Date: 11/04/2026 13:30 PM PST Description: We identified CVE-2026-122266, an issue in Amazon EKS Network Policy Agent (aws-network-policy-agent). Improper isolation of shared eBPF connection tracking state might allow an authenticated adjacent user to bypass NetworkPolicy ingress enforcement on co-located pods. Impacted versions: - aws-network-policy-agent < 1.3.7 - Amazon VPC CNI Managed Add-on < 1.22.3 Refer to the article below for the most up-to-date and complete information. Read this article
title: CVE-2026-122266 - Improper isolation of shared resources in aws-network-policy-agent in Amazon EKS

summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-171-AWS Publication Date: 11/05/2026 08:30 AM PST Description: GluonTS is an open-source Python library for probabilistic time series modeling. We identified CVE-2026-119083, an issue in the archive extraction utility in GluonTS before 0.17.0. An actor who supplies a crafted tar archive containing symbolic or hard links might be able to write arbitrary files outside the intended extraction directory with the privileges of the extracting process. Impacted versions: < 0.17.0 Refer to the article below for the most up-to-date and complete information. Read this article
title: CVE-2026-119083 - GluonTS arbitrary file write during archive extraction

summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-172-AWS Publication Date: 11/05/2026 20:00 PM PST Description: An issue in the APT package manager (CVE-2026-109518) affects Ubuntu and Debian operating systems. Under specific conditions, when APT is configured to use HTTP package sources with retry settings enabled, a third party with a network position between the host and the package mirror could cause APT to install a package that did not pass verification. Updated APT packages are available from Canonical (USN-8996-1) and Debian (DSA-6607-1). The following fixed versions address this issue: - Ubuntu 22.04 LTS: apt 2.4.15ubuntu0.1 - Ubuntu 24.04 LTS: apt 2.8.4ubuntu0.1 - Ubuntu 26.04 LTS: apt 3.2.1ubuntu0.1 - Debian (DSA-6607-1): See Debian Security Advisory for version details Customers running Ubuntu or Debian-based Amazon EC2 instances or container images should apply the updates. For details, see the full AWS Security Bulletin. Read this article
title: CVE-2026-109518 - APT package manager that affects Ubuntu and Debian operating systems

summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-173-AWS Publication Date: 11/06/2026 09:00 AM PST Description: We identified CVE-2026-122193, an OS command injection issue in an example provided in the set-up documentation. The example included a script that creates AWS Systems Manager (SSM) documents (Rex-RO and Rex-RW) for running scripts on managed instances. Due to how the example script handled input parameters, a user with permissions to invoke the SSM document could supply crafted input that would run unintended operating system commands on the managed instance, outside of the REX sandbox. The scriptArgs parameter is affected by the same class of issue. Impacted versions: This is not an issue in a shipped REX artifact version. Refer to the article below for the most up-to-date and complete information. Read this article
title: CVE-2026-122193 - Issue with Trusted Remote Execution Setup Guide - OS command injection in the example SSM documents in Trusted Remote Execution (REX)

summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-166-AWS Publication Date: 11/06/2026 10:00 AM PST Description: We identified two issues in the Babelfish TDS protocol layer: - CVE-2026-119923: A memory-safety issue in the TDS connection-handshake handling could allow a remote, unauthenticated actor to affect the database process. - CVE-2026-119924: A memory-safety issue in the TDS remote-procedure-call request handling could allow a remote, authenticated actor to read adjacent process memory or cause a denial of service. Refer to the article below for the most up-to-date and complete information. Read this article
title: CVE-2026-119923 and CVE-2026-119924: Issues with Babelfish for Aurora PostgreSQL

summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-174-AWS Publication Date: 11/09/2026 13:00 PM PST Description: AWS ParallelCluster CLI is an open source command line tool, distributed on PyPI as aws-parallelcluster. We identified CVE-2026-124033, an issue where the export-cluster-logs and export-image-logs commands in the AWS ParallelCluster CLI before version 3.16.0 contain a relative path traversal issue. An authenticated remote user with write access to the log export Amazon S3 bucket could use a crafted S3 object key to write files outside the intended export directory on the machine running the command. Impacted versions: >= 3.0.0 AND < 3.16.0 Refer to the article for the most up-to-date and complete information. Read this article
title: CVE-2026-124033 - Relative path traversal in the log export commands in AWS ParallelCluster CLI

summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-175-AWS Publication Date: 11/09/2026 14:15 PM PST Description: Amazon Braket SDK is an open source Python library that customers use to run quantum tasks and hybrid jobs on Amazon Braket. We identified CVE-2026-124034, an issue in the local hybrid job input data download in the Amazon Braket SDK. And we identified CVE-2026-124035, an issue in the error mitigation schema validation in Amazon Braket Schemas, the library the Amazon Braket SDK uses to parse quantum task results. Impacted versions: - amazon-braket-sdk >= 1.10.0 AND < 1.127.7 - amazon-braket-schemas >= 1.17.0 AND < 1.32.2 Refer to the article for the most up-to-date and complete information. Read this article
title: CVE-2026-124034, CVE-2026-124035: Issues with Amazon Braket SDK

summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-176-AWS Publication Date: 11/10/2026 08:30 AM PST Description: We identified CVE-2026-125271 of AWS API MCP Server. The server normalized operation names incorrectly before comparing them to the operator ' s security policy, so operations whose names contain consecutive capital letters never matched a correctly written denyList or elicitList entry. This might allow an actor to execute AWS API operations that the operator's security policy was configured to deny or require elicitation for. Impacted versions: >= 0.2.13 AND < 1.5.1 Refer to the article for the most up-to-date and complete information.
title: CVE-2026-125271 - AWS API MCP Server Security Policy Bypass via Incorrect Operation Name Normalization

summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-177-AWS Publication Date: 11/10/2026 10:45 AM PST Description: Untrusted search path in the cross-user process launcher in Open Job Description (OpenJD) Sessions for Python before 0.11.0, as used in the AWS Deadline Cloud worker agent before 0.33.0, on Linux might allow an authenticated remote user with permission to submit jobs to a queue to execute arbitrary code as the worker agent OS user and obtain the AWS credentials held by the worker agent via a crafted job that modifies the PATH environment variable. Impacted versions: - openjd-sessions < 0.11.0 - deadline-cloud-worker-agent < 0.33.0 Refer to the article for the most up-to-date and complete information.
title: CVE-2026-126087 - Untrusted search path in OpenJD Sessions for Python and the AWS Deadline Cloud worker agent
